name: trader_joe — agent-workflow bootstrap
initializeCommand: sh -c 'd="${AGENT_KIT_PATH:-$HOME/repos/agent-workflow}"; test -d "$d/skills" || { echo "AGENT_KIT_PATH does not resolve to a kit clone: $d" >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "${AGENT_HOME_PATH:-$HOME/.claude-agent-homes/trader_joe}"; s="${AGENT_MCP_SHARE_PATH:-}"; if [ -z "$s" ]; then [ -n "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-}" ] || { echo "Neither AGENT_MCP_SHARE_PATH nor XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set in the IDE environment; set AGENT_MCP_SHARE_PATH=/tmp/trader_joe_agent_mcp-$(id -u) there (compose.yml cannot compute that fallback)." >&2; exit 1; }; s="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/trader_joe_agent_mcp"; fi; case "$s" in /*) ;; *) echo "AGENT_MCP_SHARE_PATH must be absolute: $s" >&2; exit 1;; esac; [ -e "$s" ] || [ -L "$s" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$s")" && mkdir -m 0700 "$s"; } 2>/dev/null; [ -e "$s" ] || [ -L "$s" ] || { echo "could not create $s" >&2; exit 1; }; if [ -L "$s" ] || [ ! -d "$s" ] || [ "$(stat -c %u:%a "$s")" != "$(id -u):700" ]; then echo "refusing $s: it must be a directory (not a symlink) owned by uid $(id -u) with mode 700; found type:uid:mode $(stat -c %F:%u:%a "$s")" >&2; exit 1; fi; n=trader_joe_devnet; docker network inspect "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create --driver bridge "$n" >/dev/null || docker network inspect "$n" >/dev/null || exit 1; m=trader_joe_agent_mcp; docker network inspect "$m" >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create --driver bridge --internal "$m" >/dev/null || docker network inspect "$m" >/dev/null || exit 1; if [ "${AGENT_MCP:-}" != off ]; then make -C "${localWorkspaceFolder}" --no-print-directory agent-mcp-up || echo "WARNING: the agent-stack MCP did not start; the devcontainer starts without it. Retry with make agent-mcp-up, or skip it with AGENT_MCP=off." >&2; fi'
